alex: Heads-up: saw sustained mem growth on Llama-MQA long-context job (50k tokens) after rope scale > 2048. Paging increased, KV residency not dropping. Repro on both kernel A and kernel B. Anyone seen 'anchor bleedthrough' before? :thinking:

maria: Noted. Can you paste a short perf profile? What's kernel selection log show?

jing: curious to see the kernel hints too.

alex: ```
perf: kernel_select -> fused_attn_v2 chosen
kv: pages_allocated=132MB pages_evicted=0 residency=98% reuse=low
rope: scale=4096 -> applied scaling factor 1.5
paging: thrash detected @ seq=32768
```

maria: Interesting — 'residency=98% but evicted=0' suggests fragmentation not true eviction. Could be slab anchoring preventing compaction. See similar in a different model but with different symptoms.

sam: Can you run with KV_DEBUG=1 and kernel_env=FORCE_COALESCE=1? Also try kernel hint `--force-legacy-allocator` to see if allocator interaction is kernel-dependent.

alex: ```
$ export KV_DEBUG=1; ./run_infer --model llama-mqa --max-tokens 50000
KV_DEBUG: slab_anchors=3 anchor_pages=[0x7f3a...,0x7f3b...,0x7f3c...]
KV_DEBUG: compaction_skipped reason=anchor_conflict
```

maria: :eyes: ok that confirms anchors. My theory: rope scaling introduces non-uniform stride which shifts page alignment -> anchors end up referencing stale page ranges => prevents coalescing -> gradual mem growth as new pages allocated instead of reusing freed ones.

jing: Could reproduce with Mistral too? If it's allocator + rope alignment, both MQA and GQA could be affected differently. Quick test: set rope_scale to 2048 and run for 10k tokens.

alex: I ran that. With rope=2048 growth stayed flat. With rope=4096 growth resumed. Mistral run shows similar but slower slope. Qwen looks fine.

perf-bot: Benchmark: llama-mqa longseq(50k) kernelA vs kernelB: kernelA memory +1.8GB over 2k steps, kernelB +1.9GB. CPU/GPU % unaffected. See /perf/reports/4791234567 for full.

sam: Next steps: 1) Add compaction pass aware of anchor references (avoid evicting anchor owners). 2) Add heuristic: when rope_scale changes > x%, trigger a KV resync/defragment. 3) Add unit test that simulates stride misalignment.

alex: I'll open a draft PR with repro harness and a perf test. Putting a canary in dedicated pool with forced rope 4096. Thanks all.

maria: Also add telemetry: slab_anchor_count, compaction_skipped_reason, last_compaction_seq. Send perf logs to eng-runtime channel when you have PR.

alex: Will do. tagging @sam @jing. Thanks :thumbsup:
